newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.
Vessels: Amanpulo loading 27,500 tonnes sugar using big bags. Sea Duty II loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bagged sugar and three to load bulk.
Road: 187 trucks carrying sugar arrived between Aug 8 and 10.

Vessels: Icarus, Global Star and Libanus each loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Mattz Spica loading 12,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Valentin Khutorsk loading 12,500 tonnes bagged sugar. Maro to load 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load bulk sugar and three to load sugar (unspecified). No vessels docked at Cargill private terminal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load bulk sugar and three to load sugar (unspecified). Loading (Aug 10): 7,858 tonnes.
Stocks: 30,469 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
